meta.title: AzerScope Beta | Night Sky Planning App

hero.title: Plan the night sky with confidence.
hero.subtitle: AzerScope helps astronomy enthusiasts plan observations with weather context, sky visibility, tools, events, and logs.
hero.note: This website does not sell subscriptions. Purchase and restore are handled inside the mobile app (store policy).

overview.label: Product
overview.title: Built for real observing nights
overview.sub: Night UX, practical calculations, and useful decisions before you go outside.

features.label: Core Experience
features.title: Before, during, and after an observation session
features.sub: AzerScope combines observation context, learning content, events, and logging in one mobile workflow.

weather.d: Night-ready weather parameters: hourly forecast of cloud cover, humidity, dew point, wind, and light pollution.

sky.d: What is visible for your location and time: Sun, Moon, planets, and deep-sky guidance with practical visibility hints.

guide.d: Events, astro calendar, practical tools, and constellation previews in one curated section.

lab.d: Learning library with tags, curated materials, and detailed object guides for reference.

events.d: Event list, detail pages, attendance confirmation, and participation history integrated into your profile.

obs.d: Personal observation journal with notes and session context, designed for future filters and statistics.

screens.label: Screens
screens.title: UI tuned for dark conditions
screens.sub: Placeholder screenshots are used now. Replace with your prepared real app screens before launch.

tools.label: AstroTools
tools.title: Field-ready calculations, not decorative widgets
tools.sub: Built from real app tools for observers and astrophotographers.
tools.d1: Telescope focal length / eyepiece focal length.
tools.d2: True field of view and Moon-in-frame context.
tools.d3: Time (HMS) and Degrees (DMS) to decimal format and back.
tools.d4: Filter suggestions by object and conditions.
tools.d5: Max exposure estimate by focal length and sensor.
tools.d7: Optimize your focus and depth of field for perfect night shots.

pricing.label: Plans
pricing.title: Transparent pricing. Purchase in app only.
pricing.sub: This is a static landing page. Purchases and restores happen inside the mobile app due to store policy.
pricing.caption: Yearly tab is shown for planning. Final store totals may vary by taxes and region.
pricing.disclaimer: Store rule note: the website shows prices for information only and never processes payments.

access.label: COMMUNITY
access.title: AzerScope is open to everyone
access.sub: All core AzerScope features are available for free. Additional statuses are used for educational programs, offline events, volunteering, and partner communities.
access.mainText: All essential AzerScope features are available to every user at no cost.
access.hacText: Members of Həvəskar Astronomlar Cəmiyyəti get access to joint observations, internal community events, and special programs.
access.eduText: Students, school clubs, and educational partners can receive special status to participate in training programs and events.
access.volText: Special status for AzerScope volunteers, event organizers, and participants in community support programs.
access.bottomNote: AzerScope is developing together with the astronomical community of Azerbaijan, educational initiatives, and partner organizations.

trust.label: Data & Trust
trust.title: Traceable sources and offline math reliability
trust.sub: AzerScope combines backend content and weather aggregation with on-device calculations for better reliability in the field.
trust.wD: Forecast and weather data are aggregated server-side from public sources and presented for night observation planning.
trust.nD: Space weather indicators and context use NOAA SWPC data.
trust.aD: Visibility calculations rely on Astronomy Engine with device time and geolocation context.
trust.lD: Light pollution index is derived from Clear Outside map-based context.
trust.pD: Content, events, and user-linked data are managed through PocketBase.
trust.rD: Part of the app logic runs locally to remain useful even without an internet connection.

partners.label: Partners
partners.title: Seeing further together
partners.sub: Our partners who support the development of AzerScope.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Before you join the beta
faq.sub: Purchase flow, access rules, and beta expectations.
faq.q1: Why can’t I buy on the website?
faq.a1: The website is informational only. Subscription purchase, renewals, and restores are handled inside the app.
faq.a2: No free plan. AzerScope offers a limited guest mode (Home, Weather, Sky).
faq.a3: The app is usable but evolving. Bugs, unfinished areas, and placeholder content may appear.
faq.q4: Will store totals match site prices?
faq.a4: Store checkout totals may vary by taxes, currency conversion, and regional rules.
faq.a5: HAC members, BSU astronomy club members, selected volunteers, and invited guests depending on program criteria.
faq.q6: Where do I follow beta updates?
faq.a6: Use the Telegram channel for beta announcements, testing updates, and release notes.
